text:
Alex M.: Hey @Jordan (People Ops) — noticed my take-home for the last two pay periods is ~12% lower. Gross looks right but federal withholding doubled.
Sophia R.: that's wild. did you do any tax form updates recently? :thinking:
Alex M.: I updated my address in the portal a month ago but didn't touch W-4. I checked the payroll export: ```EMP_ID: 2314, GROSS: 7,500.00, FED_WH: 1,650.00 (usual ~825.00)``` Looks like two federal withholding lines applied.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, Alex. Can you DM me the payroll portal snapshot? I'll escalate to Payroll. Please also confirm your filing status on file.
Alex M.: Sent the screenshot. Filing status is Single, no extra withholding. I also see two entries under "Tax Forms" — one active and one submitted with the same year.
Payroll Bot: Ticket #PL-11287 created for payroll ops. Assigned to @Sophia R. Scheduled investigation window: next payroll cycle.
Sophia R.: I'm looking now. Quick check: the duplicate W-4 was submitted when we migrated forms last quarter. It appears both the legacy and new W-4 were read by the payroll ingestion job for certain employees.
Alex M.: Any ETA for reversal? Next pay cycle is in 6 days, that would be tight.
Sophia R.: Good catch. We can either issue a manual ACH adjustment before payroll runs, or credit the overwithheld amount on the next cycle. Given it's two periods, I recommend a manual correction this week. I'll confirm with Finance.
Jordan (People Ops): I'll approve the manual adjustment if Finance signs off. Alex, can you confirm your bank details in case we need to push an off-cycle ACH? :raised_hands:
Alex M.: Confirmed, same account. Thanks.
Sophia R.: Finance approved manual correction. Payroll Ops will run the reversal today and issue an off-cycle ACH for ~1,650. Expect a confirmation email and a corrected paystub by EOD. Payroll Bot will update ticket when done.
Payroll Bot: Ticket #PL-11287 status: In Progress -> Correction scheduled by Payroll Ops. Estimated completion: 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC.
Alex M.: Amazing, thank you all! :heart:
Sophia R.: Follow-up: we'll also add a one-time check in the ingestion pipeline to ignore duplicate active W-4s with identical timestamps. Filing bug GH#5689.
Jordan (People Ops): Closing loop: Alex, let us know if the ACH shows up. We'll also send a brief postmortem in #eng-payroll later today.
Alex M.: Will do. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
